name: burstpoint-physics-shorts-engine
description: AI-Guided Physics Simulation & Automated Shorts Production Engine

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let rel = req.url.split('?')[0].replace(/^\//, ''); if (!rel) rel = 'index.html'; let p = path.resolve(__dirname, rel); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()) { const ext = path.extname(p); const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json' }; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[ext] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }); server.listen(8080, () => { console.log('Studio running at http://localhost:8080'); exec('start http://localhost:8080'); });"
